chapter_title_en: Winds Rising Overseas, The Sacred Sanctum Fragment
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 555: The Real Reason Behind the Beast Tide and Han Li's New Burden
chapter_meta_description: The demon lords reveal the true motive for the Deep Sea Beast Tide: a stolen sacred relic. Han Li realizes his mysterious copper slab may be the very item the entire war was fought over.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey - Chapter 555: The Secret Behind the Beast Tide
og_description: Han Li learns why the demon race really attacked the human islands. It’s not revenge—it’s a quest for an ancient relic. And he might just be carrying it.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 555: Han Li is a walking hot potato again
twitter_description: The demon lords just admitted the whole invasion was to get back a sacred artifact. Guess who’s got a mysterious copper slab in his pocket?

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient demon race ancestral relic, said to record the "Three Sacred Sacred Art." The fragments are scattered and lost, but the item holds immense cultural and political value among the sea demon clans.
A high-level transformed demon cultivator of the Flood Dragon clan. Arrogant, proud of his clan's heritage, and speaks with the cold authority of a predator.
Feng Xi's demonic form. A cunning and patient ruler among the sea demons, he is the one orchestrating the treasure refinement and holding Han Li captive.
One of the nine sons of the Dragon King in Chinese mythology. In this story, it is a Grade 7 demon beast belonging to the royal clan of the Thousand-Fathom Sea.
A legendary artifact that allows its user to command the demon beasts of a vast region. Its activation requires the user to consume their own essence blood, a costly sacrifice.
A particularly vicious and difficult-to-expel variant of Chaos Evil Qi, refined from the body of a slain demonic-path cultivator. Even high-level demons find it challenging to remove.
A legendary cultivation art from the ancient demon race, said to be recorded across multiple Sacred Sanctum Fragments. The art is considered lost.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the demon race really start the war?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The war was not just about human cultivators getting arrogant. The real trigger was the humans killing a Grade 7 Suanni Beast and stealing the "Sacred Sanctum Fragment," a sacred demon race relic.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Chaos Demon Qi' inside Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a particularly dangerous and stubborn form of Evil Qi that Feng Xi crafted from the body of a dead demonic-path cultivator. It is even harder to expel than normal Chaos Evil Qi.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Han Li actually have the Sacred Sanctum Fragment?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter strongly implies it. He recently acquired a copper slab with demon cultivation techniques on it, and the description matches the relic the demons are desperately seeking.
